title: 第24章【冥婚】帮手
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着赵东海的离开，那些白骨和怪物像是收到了指令一样，他们也没有再继续攻击三人，而是全部退了出去，站在门口，甚至是将整个大堂围了起来。

“这是什么意思？”林婉脸色苍白的问。

“赵东海觉得杀了我们没有必要，只要我们完不成任务，一样会死。”顾原叹了口气，不过并没有沮丧，毕竟只要不是彻底死了，那一切都还有翻盘的希望。

“那我们现在应该怎么办？”顾方坐在地上，半个衣服都被血染红。

“正面交战肯定是行不通了，只能想其他办法。”顾原此刻脑子里也没了注意，毕竟外面全是怪物，只要出去估计就会被撕碎。

没有人接话，大堂里安静了很长一段时间，三个人靠着墙壁坐在地上，各自处理着自己的伤口。

顾原撕下一截衣袖，缠住手臂上还在渗血的伤口，绑紧的时候疼得他倒吸一口凉气。

他低头看了一眼脚边，铜钱剑被赵东海踩过后踢到了墙角，剑身上又多了一道裂痕，他弯腰把剑捡起来，试了试分量，还算趁手。

现在如果能帮上忙的就只剩下一个人了，那就是张晓，但顾原并不是一个喜欢将希望放在别人身上的人，只不过自己现在是真没办法了。

“希望他能赶得及吧。”顾原喃喃道。

怀中的方清的三件拼图还留有余温，好在刚才这些东西没有掉出来。

与此同时，外面开始响起了此起彼伏的交谈声，透过窗户看去，发现院子里已经零零星星有了一些村民，那些村民他早上还见过。

“已经开始有村民陆续过来了，我们得抓紧时间逃出去了。”顾原皱着眉头说道。

没过一会，院子中的人陆陆续续的多了起来，少说也有几十人，他们已经坐在了座位上，似乎在等着开饭了。

而就在这些人群中，有一个人影吸引了顾原的注意力。

那人穿的破破烂烂，身上背着一个破包，看起来极为眼熟。

顾原几乎是一下就认出了张晓，而张晓似乎也是注意到了他，转过头来朝着大堂摆摆手。

这一下，顾原悬着的心总算是放到了肚子里。

Page (1/3)

As Zhao Donghai left, the bones and monsters seemed to have received instructions. They did not continue to attack the three of them, but all retreated, stood at the door, and even surrounded the entire lobby.

"What does this mean?" Lin Wan asked with a pale face.

"Zhao Donghai doesn't think it's necessary to kill us. As long as we fail to complete the task, we will still die." Gu Yuan sighed, but he was not depressed. After all, as long as we are not completely dead, there is still hope of turning everything around.

"Then what should we do now?" Gu Fang sat on the ground, half of his clothes stained red with blood.

"Fighting head-on is definitely not feasible. We can only think of other ways." Gu Yuan didn't pay attention at the moment. After all, there were monsters outside. If he went out, he would probably be torn apart.

No one answered, and the lobby was quiet for a long time. The three people sat on the ground leaning against the wall, each treating their own wounds.

Gu Yuan tore off a piece of his sleeve and wrapped it around the bleeding wound on his arm. When he tied it tightly, the pain made him gasp.

He lowered his head and glanced at his feet. Zhao Donghai stepped on the copper coin sword and kicked it to the corner. There was another crack on the sword. He bent down to pick up the sword, tested the weight, and found that it was in his hand.

If there is only one person left who can help now, that is Zhang Xiao, but Gu Yuan is not a person who likes to put his hope in others, but he really has no choice now.

"I hope he can make it in time." Gu Yuan murmured.

Fang Qing's three puzzle pieces in his arms were still warm, but fortunately they didn't fall out just now.

At the same time, chatter began to sound outside. Looking through the window, he found that there were already some villagers scattered in the yard. Those villagers he had seen in the morning.

"Villers have begun to come over one after another. We have to hurry up and escape." Gu Yuan said with a frown.

After a while, there were more and more people in the courtyard, at least dozens of them. They were already sitting on their seats and seemed to be waiting for the meal.

And among these crowds, there was a figure that attracted Gu Yuan's attention.

The man was dressed in tatters and had a tattered bag on his back. He looked very familiar.

Gu Yuan recognized Zhang Xiao almost immediately, and Zhang Xiao seemed to have noticed him, turning his head and waving towards the lobby.

At this moment, Gu Yuan's anxious heart finally settled in his stomach.
